description:
The single-valued `materializers/<tag>` family was born in 5d65c846 and replaced by the set-valued `materializers/<tag>/<worker_id>` in b54976e9 (#198, q67.21.9). Both commits are AFTER tag 0.6.1 (2026-08-19) — git rev-list 0.6.1..develop contains both, and 0.6.1's system_keys.ex has no materializers/ family at all, only materializer_keys/<end_key>. The shape existed only on develop, between two unreleased commits, so no released cluster can hold it and the dual-shape reader plus recovery's rewrite-and-clear migration (#208) is carrying weight for a state that cannot exist.

Removes: SystemKeys.legacy_materializer_key/1 and the {:legacy_materializer_key, tag} parse arm; Values.decode_materializer_ref/1; Reader's legacy decode clause; MaterializerBootstrapPhase's legacy_keys collection (read_prior_refs returns {:ok, refs} again); PersistencePhase.migrate_legacy_materializer_keys/2; RecoveryAttempt.legacy_materializer_keys; the three tests covering them.

NOT touched: the bootstrap-record fallback for records predating system_materializers (q67.21.21 defect 1) — a different legacy, still reachable on develop clusters; and the term_to_binary shard-tag fallback (q67.20.7).
title: Drop the pre-q67.21.9 single-valued materializer migration: the shape never shipped
